d:
Unexplained voices captured in pitch-black hallways, sudden temperature drops, and phantom figures caught on thermal cameras. Step into the nerve center with Zak Bagans and the crew in Ghost Adventures for the final review of the evidence breaking down the most chilling audio and visual anomalies from their darkest lockdowns. Every frame and EVP recording is analyzed closely to uncover what truly lurks behind locked doors.
Watch Ghost Adventures Season 10 Episodes 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10 & 12 on Discovery Channel India.
